Keeps Inkay up to date for **Pretendo** and **Protarium**, in every Aroma environment on your SD card.

- One list with all environments, showing the installed network and version and whether an update is available
- Downloads the latest release from the official Pretendo and Protarium repositories
- Safe install: the download is checked first, and the old Inkay is put back if anything fails
- Background music (Y to turn it on or off)
- Switches off a second Inkay under another file name, so it doesn't load twice

**Install:** put `inkay_updater.wuhb` in `sd:/wiiu/apps` and start Inkay Updater from the Wii U Menu.

Controls: Up/Down environment, Left/Right network, A install/update, + check again, Y music on/off, B restart after installing.
